name: KRAKacquisition Corp Unit
summary: KRAK Acquisition Corp. functions as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), established with the core mission of identifying and completing a business combination—such as a merger, acquisition, share exchange, or reorganization—with an existing operational business or multiple businesses. The investment units offered by the company generally consist of one Class A common stock and a fractional redeemable warrant, with the specific terms detailed in its official offering documents.
